arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Andrew Tulumello argued the Montana Supreme Court found general jurisdiction based on continuous business activity.
Saharsky argued the Court must determine if Section 56 or Montana law makes the defendant amenable to service.
Ms. Murray argued injured rail workers have sued negligent employers in any state where railroads do business for over a century.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: BNSF Railway faces a lawsuit in Montana. The company argues Montana courts lack general jurisdiction. Workers claim the company's continuous business activity creates jurisdiction.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: This case defines where companies face general jurisdiction. It determines if continuous business activity alone grants courts power over unrelated claims. The outcome shapes the geographic reach of state court authority over large corporations.
